newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian central bank sells 238 bln rbls of bills.
newsitem.headline: Russian central bank sells 238 bln rbls of bills.

text.p: Russia's central bank sold 238.00 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Thursday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 21076 issue closed on Thursday at 85.47 percent, the 21078 issue closed at 84.94 percent, the 21079 issue closed at 84.40 percent, the 21080 issue closed at 84.26 percent and the 23007 issue closed at 86.72 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
Full details of recent central bank transactions in the secondary market for the Finance Ministry can be seen on CBGKOSEC.
